name: pytest-results-actions
description: Post pytest results to the workflow summary

path.description:
A list of JUnit XML files, directories containing the former, and wildcard 
patterns to process. See @actions/glob for supported patterns.

summary.description: Add a summary of the results at the top of the report

display-options.description:
Select which results should be included in the report. 
Follows the same syntax as `pytest -r`

fail-on-empty.description: Fail the workflow if no JUnit XML was found

title.description: Title of the test results section in the workflow summary
